milestone.describes: A run is under way: the character runs down a 3D city street past obstacles and collectibles, with a counting-down timer, a rising score, a PAUSE button and the skyline HUD.

steps.expect: The language select screen, with SELECT in the bottom left.
The sound question — accepting the default language, English.
The title card, then the 3D intro cutscene with dialogue.
SKIP advances past the first cutscene scene.
The main menu: PLAY / EXTRAS / HIDEOUT / OPTIONS / HELP.

The tutorial is dismissed and the run starts: the street scrolls, the timer counts down and the score rises. Left alone the round ends and a TAP THE SCREEN TO START prompt appears, which starts another — the loop closes.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window. They come from the fractions recorded in the app note: SELECT/DONE at 0.13,0.93; SKIP at 0.88,0.94; the tutorial dismissal at 0.50,0.55.
Do NOT tap SKIP on the tutorial screen. There it means 'back' and returns to the main menu; tap the middle of the play area instead. That cost several runs to notice.
The four SKIP taps are spaced a few seconds apart on purpose — the cutscene is several scenes and one tap skips one scene.
Steering is by simulated tilt (hold the right mouse button and move the cursor). It is not part of this route: the run starts and persists without it, which is what the milestone needs.
